people.name: Teman
people.line: Region and town in Edom, known for wisdom

translations.web: God came from Teman, the Holy One from Mount Paran. His glory covered the heavens, and his praise filled the earth.
translations.bsb: God came from Teman, and the Holy One from Mount Paran. Selah His glory covered the heavens, and His praise filled the earth.
